body:
A Worthwhile Experience
It's Sunday, I have been drinking the night before. My Sundays usually consist of some kind of drug and isolation, as it's the only day of the week I have to be alone for the whole day. The following week I have off work. My flat is messy but nothing to make me uncomfortable. The plan is to try bk-2c-b for the first time. I will be doing this alone. I ate a bowl of porridge at around 11am. I'm in a very average mood, as is typical after an unfulfilling night of drinking alone, but my life is going well so I am in a good place.
I have moderate experience with LSD, 1p-LSD, MDMA and have once taken 5-MEO-MIPT, as well as having copious experience with cannabis I have dabbled with a few other non-psychedelic drugs. I've also experimented with various nootropics.
14:14 11/12/2016 - 100mg ingestion by capsule. I immediately go for a jog along a nice footpath and around a small lake.
14:57 11/12/2016 - No noticeable effects at all so far, good or bad, I start playing speed chess to electronic dance music.
15:15 11/12/2016 - first noticeable changes, a slight delay on visuals, very subtle. Akin to the first obvious effect I can remember from taking LSD for the first time. I write the introduction to this report.
15:28 11/12/2016 - I put on 'Floating Points - For Marmish Part II' on loop - very chilled jazzy good vibes and begin a session of my favourite RTS game.
15:43 11/12/2016 - No obvious effects.
16:14 11/12/2016 - Still no obvious effects. Playing familiar games to familiar music probably doesn't help.
16:22 11/12/2016 - I start cooking potatoes. Floating Points is sounding a bit better than usual.
16:37 11/12/2016 - I feel relaxed. I take a shower. It's noticably nicer.
16:55 11/12/2016 - I prepare to eat my potatoes with tuna and notice a little smile with everything I do. These potatoes are really soft. A very similar feeling to taking 12.5ug of LSD. For it being just potatoes and tuna this meal is really tasty. I'm in a very good mood. I add sriracha chilli sauce and it's spicier than usual but, maybe I added too much.
17:36 11/12/2016 - Having a great time decorating my messy flat by blu-tacking pictures, art and 'art' onto the walls. Including a friends long lost bank card, a bag of weed and picture of two unicorns in love, given to me by my first girlfriend of several years. The relationship died a messy death. I am an artist.
17:51 11/12/2016 - I've been living in my flat for 4 months. I now have curtains. I feel good.
18:09 11/12/2016 - Still artifying my flat. Pepe Bradock - Deep Burnt is a huge tune. I feel great. Very minor visual distortions. More like a fuzziness when I focus on something. I'm definitely up and never really felt a come up.
18:29 11/12/2016 - Dancing around my flat considering hosting a party. My pupils are big.
18:48 11/12/2016 - Curious to see if I could have sex like this. I'm completely unaroused but after a minute of stimulus I feel horny and am able to successfully masturbate.
19:10 11/12/2016 - Mild introspection.
19:38 11/12/2016 - I feel very tired.
21:56 11/12/2016 - Tried to nap, lasted about five minutes. Still feeling great. Emancipator - Soon It will Be Cold Enough to Build Fires is beautiful. I don't really feel tired anymore.
00:04 12/12/2016 - I've been listening to podcasts and social media-ing. Laughed a lot. A girl friend has come round and I'm being very assertive, feel very confident and playful. Very good mood still present.
10:38 12/12/2016 - Had sex which felt very normal, nothing special, took at least an hour to fall asleep which I didn't expect would happen. Felt very groggy to start with waking up but now twenty minutes later I feel very fresh and ready for the day!
14:03 13/12/2016 - I feel depressed and my pupils are tiny, although I have not taken prozac for three weeks, done no exercise and been eating shit food. Depression subsided shortly after.
Overall, a very worthwhile experience. I think this would be a great substance for a festival.
